remaining_icons.name: Real Power
remaining_icons.action: Wick crouches beneath a small crown dangling on puppet strings, ignoring it, one mitten pointing up the strings to where they vanish.
remaining_icons.rules_text: I: in any organisation, you can tell who actually holds the power, whatever the titles say. II: and that person agrees to see you.

remaining_icons.name: Charge!
remaining_icons.action: Wick sprints flat-out, body leaning almost horizontal, a bayonet rifle levelled ahead, mouth wide in a roar, dust kicking up behind.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per turn, a charge of 3 or more tiles straight at an enemy costs no movement AP.

remaining_icons.name: Make Way
remaining_icons.action: Wick strolls chin-high, mittens clasped behind its back, no weapon at all, as two walls of shoulder silhouettes lean away on either side.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Moving past enemies never triggers their reactions, and crowds part for you.

remaining_icons.name: Just the Repairman
remaining_icons.action: Caught in a searchlight cone, Wick strolls past waving cheerily, a big toolbox swinging from the other mitten.
remaining_icons.rules_text: When you're spotted sneaking inside an enemy's sight, 50% chance they take you for maintenance staff, as long as you're carrying a toolbox.

remaining_icons.name: Spoon-Feed
remaining_icons.action: Wick kneels and holds a huge spoon out to the viewer, a small geometric sigil (lines and angles, no letters) balanced in its bowl.
remaining_icons.rules_text: 2 AP, explain an enemy's weakness so simply that every ally who hears it gets +2 on attacks against that enemy this round.

remaining_icons.name: Cultured
remaining_icons.action: Wick sits on a stool strumming a small round-bodied lute, eyes closed, one boot tapping, a few music notes drifting up.
remaining_icons.rules_text: +1 on Ingenuity and Charisma whenever the talk turns to art, history or holo-dramas: you blend in with anyone who loves them.

remaining_icons.name: Dance of Iron
remaining_icons.action: Wick turns a one-handed cartwheel, fully upside down, the other mitten firing a pistol back under its body, a muzzle-flash star.
remaining_icons.rules_text: After each successful dodge, fire one shot at the attacker for 0 AP.

remaining_icons.name: Cold Read
remaining_icons.action: Wick crouches and peers through a big heart-shaped keyhole plate held up in both mittens like a frame.
remaining_icons.rules_text: One Analyze action on an NPC reveals what they want most.

remaining_icons.name: Fire Sermon
remaining_icons.action: Wick lunges forward, thrusting a burning open book with blank pages overhead, mouth wide mid-sermon, radiant lines behind.
remaining_icons.rules_text: While you preach (2 AP), your Blessings also leave enemies in range Shaken.

remaining_icons.name: Silent Partner
remaining_icons.action: Wick crouch-walks behind a big leafy branch, holding it as cover for itself and a tiny Wick silhouette tiptoeing in step beside it.
remaining_icons.rules_text: An ally next to you shares your stealth.

remaining_icons.name: Verse of War
remaining_icons.action: Wick strikes a poet's pose, one mitten over its lantern heart, the other flung out as a long soul ribbon unspools in one flowing curve.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Outbursts cast while you speak in verse get +1 tile of range and +10% damage.

remaining_icons.name: Between Heartbeats
remaining_icons.action: Wick steps calmly around a bullet hanging frozen in the air beside its head, one mitten raised to flick it aside.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per combat, when an enemy starts an action in your sight, take a 2 AP action first.

remaining_icons.name: Siege Engine
remaining_icons.action: Wick barges shoulder-first through a brick wall, bricks flying and bouncing harmlessly off its shell, never breaking stride.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Shove and Break cost 1 AP less, and nothing can knock you back.

remaining_icons.name: Dead Signal
remaining_icons.action: Wick hangs one-handed from a security camera's bracket arm, pulling its cable plug with the other mitten; the camera's head droops.
remaining_icons.rules_text: While in stealth, disable one electronic device within 3 tiles for 1 AP, silently.

remaining_icons.name: Twin Souls
remaining_icons.action: Wick sits on the ground holding a tin-can telephone to its head; the taut string runs straight up out of frame.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per session, ask your twin soul in the upper realm one question. Your mid-level Outbursts can draw on a third school.

remaining_icons.name: The Voice
remaining_icons.action: Wick stands at parade rest, officer's baton under one arm, staring dead ahead; one heavy sound ring drops from its screen and flattens the dust.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per session, give an order in combat; enemy rank-and-file who fail a Heart save obey it for one action.

remaining_icons.name: War Footing
remaining_icons.action: Wick stomps down from a high knee and the ground cracks around it into a three-by-three grid of broken slabs, cape snapping.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Your threats never backfire: a failed Intimidation check costs you nothing. Any enemy that ends its move in the 3×3 around you loses 2 AP immediately.
remaining_icons.flavour: The Hellraisers call it marching on the enemy's nerves.

remaining_icons.name: Last Charge
remaining_icons.action: Wick leaps forward at the end of a long charge, sword raised in both mittens, wrapped in a big bubble shield, speed lines far behind.
remaining_icons.rules_text: After charging an enemy from 7 m or more, gain a shield of 15 × your Armour Class (at least 15) for one turn. Melee hits made during the charge deal 1.5× base melee damage.
remaining_icons.flavour: Every army has a song for running at guns. You know all of them.

remaining_icons.name: Angel of the Trenches
remaining_icons.action: Wick slides in on its knees through a spray of dirt, catching a limp hand dropping into frame, cape flaring behind like wings.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per combat, when an ally within your Movement would drop to 0 HP, move to them and stabilise them out of turn, for 0 AP.
remaining_icons.flavour: The 258th Medical Unit's highest honour has no medal. The soldiers just say your name.

remaining_icons.name: Every Lie Is a Door
remaining_icons.action: Wick strides unhurried through a towering door that swings wide open for it, tipping a cap toward the viewer.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per session, walk into any guarded place by naming a reason to be there. You're believed until someone draws a weapon.
remaining_icons.flavour: You don't break in. You get invited.

remaining_icons.name: Twin Discipline
remaining_icons.action: Wick leaps and claps both mittens overhead: hard geometric sigil lines trail one arm, flowing soul ribbons the other, fusing into one burst.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Fuse a Sigil and an Outburst into one cast: the Sigil sets the shape, the Outburst sets the school. Pay both costs.
remaining_icons.flavour: The Science Team says it can't be done. The Institute says it shouldn't be. You do it anyway.

remaining_icons.name: Bite the Bullet
remaining_icons.action: Wick, dented and smoking, pushes up off one knee with a big bullet clamped sideways across its screen like a bit, one fist planted on the ground.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per combat, when you would drop to 0 HP, take one more full turn first. You drop at the end of it unless you've been healed above 0 by then.
remaining_icons.deed: fight through an entire combat below a quarter of your max HP.

remaining_icons.name: Sixth Sense
remaining_icons.action: Wick crouches low with its capelet pulled up like a hood, a humming tuning fork held above its head; a dotted trail of footprints creeps in from behind it.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Hidden enemies within 3 tiles of you are revealed to you and your whole squad.
remaining_icons.deed: catch someone tailing the squad before they strike.

remaining_icons.name: What Could Be
remaining_icons.action: Wick holds up a hand mirror toward the viewer; the mirror shows a small sun and a sprouting flower where the frame around Wick is bare.
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per session, before a major decision, the Narrator shows you a brief vision of the best outcome within reach, and one way to get there.
remaining_icons.deed: talk someone out of a terrible choice by showing them where it leads.

remaining_icons.name: Last Wall
remaining_icons.action: Wick plants itself in the gap of a broken brick wall, arms locked wide across the hole, feet braced; a flattened bullet drops off its chest plate.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per combat, an attack that would drop you to 0 HP leaves you at 1 HP instead, and you take no damage until the start of your next turn.
remaining_icons.flavour: The wall doesn't fall. The wall decides when it's done.

remaining_icons.name: Walking Wounded
remaining_icons.action: Wick strides forward mid-step, one leg wrapped in a long trailing bandage, flinging a crutch away over its shoulder.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Injuries never cost you AP or Movement. Below half your max HP, you get +1 AP at the start of each turn (the AP ceiling still applies).
remaining_icons.flavour: Hurt is information. You've read it all before.

remaining_icons.name: Skin Map
remaining_icons.action: Wick kneels low with one mitten pressed flat to the floor; big ripple rings spread out from the palm across the ground to the frame edges.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: You always know where every creature within 6 tiles is, hidden or not. Darkness, smoke and invisibility hide nothing inside that range from you.
remaining_icons.flavour: The air moves around them. The floor remembers their weight. You don't need eyes.

remaining_icons.name: Earthbreaker
remaining_icons.action: Wick at the top of an overhead swing, both mittens on a huge sledgehammer, about to bring it down; a deep starburst crack already splits the ground below.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per combat, 4 AP: strike the ground in reach. Every creature in the 3×3 around the point of impact takes your melee damage and is knocked Prone, and all cover in that area is destroyed.
remaining_icons.flavour: They took cover. You took the cover.

remaining_icons.name: Nothing Left to Fear
remaining_icons.action: Wick sits cross-legged on top of a giant sleeping monster's horned head (only the head top shows, filling the bottom of the frame), calmly sipping from a teacup.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: You're immune to Fear. Allies within 3 tiles who can see you can't be made Afraid either.
remaining_icons.flavour: You've already met the worst thing. It blinked first.

remaining_icons.name: The Name They Whisper
remaining_icons.action: Wick stands in a bright open doorway, back-lit, its long shadow stretching all the way toward the viewer; two tiny Wick silhouettes duck behind cover in the foreground.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: When combat starts, every enemy who knows who you are saves against Fear. An enemy at half HP or less that can see you, and fails a Heart save at the end of its turn, surrenders.
remaining_icons.flavour: They tell stories about you to keep their recruits in line.

remaining_icons.name: Never There
remaining_icons.action: Wick mid-backflip, upside down, with two fading dashed outlines of itself trailing behind; a bullet streaks through the empty outline.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Your first move each turn provokes no reactions, and ranged attacks against you take −4 while you're moving.
remaining_icons.flavour: Aim where they'll be. They won't be there either.

remaining_icons.name: Trick Shot
remaining_icons.action: Wick fires a revolver backwards over its own shoulder without looking; a dotted line bounces off a tin can and curves out of frame.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per turn, a ranged attack can ricochet: it ignores cover, and if it hits, a second enemy within 2 tiles of the target takes half the damage.
remaining_icons.flavour: Off the pipe, off the plate, into the second one. You called it.

remaining_icons.name: Before the Blink
remaining_icons.action: Wick explodes out of a sprinter's crouch, already one stride gone, beside a big pocket stopwatch whose hand still points straight up.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: You always act first in round 1, whatever the initiative roll, and you get a second reaction each round.
remaining_icons.flavour: Initiative is a polite word for who was faster. That was you.

remaining_icons.name: Vanishing Act
remaining_icons.action: Wick whips its capelet out into a huge magician's sweep; the lower half of its body is already gone, shown only as a dotted outline.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per combat, 2 AP: drop out of sight wherever you are, even in plain view. You stay hidden until you attack or someone touches you.
remaining_icons.flavour: Everyone saw you. Nobody can say where you went.

remaining_icons.name: Overhaul
remaining_icons.action: Wick sits on the ground cradling a rebuilt rifle across its lap like a prize, one extra rail gleaming, a wrench tucked behind its head like a pencil.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Field Repair costs 1 AP and restores twice as much. At a long rest, give one weapon or device a permanent extra mod slot (once per item).
remaining_icons.flavour: It left the factory good. It leaves your bench better.

remaining_icons.name: Nothing Gets Past
remaining_icons.action: Wick kneels with a rifle shouldered inside a wide fan of light sweeping out like a lighthouse beam; three small dash marks sit in the beam where shots landed.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Your Overwatch doesn't stop at the first enemy: every enemy that moves into your line before your next turn draws a shot, as long as you held the AP for it. Each shot hits before the enemy's move finishes.
remaining_icons.flavour: You held the line of sight. All of it.

remaining_icons.name: Clean Draw
remaining_icons.action: Wick stands on one foot, one finger tracing a single perfect geometric sigil in the air in one unbroken line; no sparks, no smoke anywhere.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per combat, draw a Sigil of any length you can draw with no Core charge and no Flux.
remaining_icons.flavour: No charge, no smoke, no Flux. Just the shape, perfectly.

remaining_icons.name: Established Fact
remaining_icons.action: Wick brings a huge rubber stamp down with both mittens onto a blank sheet, leaving one big checkmark.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per session, state a fact about the technology, biology or history in the scene. The Narrator makes it true, unless it contradicts something already shown.
remaining_icons.flavour: You checked. It's true now.

remaining_icons.name: Closing Argument
remaining_icons.action: Wick walks away from the viewer, back turned, cape swinging, having just let go of a microphone that's falling behind it.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per scene, make your closing argument. Every NPC listening who isn't ruled by fear or faith accepts its logic, even if they hate where it leads. They can still refuse to act on it.
remaining_icons.flavour: You didn't win the argument. You ended it.

remaining_icons.name: Solid Image
remaining_icons.action: Wick leans its whole weight back against a wall drawn in dashed lines, arms folded, and the dashed wall holds it up.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per combat, one of your projections becomes real for a round: a wall blocks movement and shots, a figure can take one hit meant for an ally.
remaining_icons.flavour: If you imagine it hard enough, it has edges.

remaining_icons.name: Case Closed
remaining_icons.action: Wick perches on the edge of a desk, slapping a thick case folder shut, its string tie flying.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Analyze reveals everything at once: HP, armour, resistances, weak points and what the target wants. Allies attacking an enemy you've analyzed get +2 to hit and +20% damage.
remaining_icons.flavour: Everything about them, in the order it matters.

remaining_icons.name: Everyone's Friend
remaining_icons.action: Wick beams as a stranger's hand (entering from the frame edge) drops a ring of keys into its open mitten.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per scene, one NPC who doesn't already hate you treats you as a trusted friend until the scene ends. They share what a friend would, and your first lie to them always lands.
remaining_icons.flavour: You've known them for ten minutes. They'd lend you their car.

remaining_icons.name: Open Hand
remaining_icons.action: Wick kneels and holds out a small flower toward an armoured gauntlet (partial, entering from the side) that is lowering its blade.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: When an enemy you can see drops to a quarter of its HP or less, offer mercy as a free action: it saves against Heart or stops fighting for the rest of the combat.
remaining_icons.flavour: You saw the moment they stopped wanting this. So did they.

remaining_icons.name: Many Hands
remaining_icons.action: Seen from above: Wick in a team huddle, its mitten at the bottom of a pile of hands stacked from every side of the frame (all partials).
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Hand-Off has no limit: give any amount of your AP to any ally within 3 tiles, once per round. An ally you can see may use your reaction as their own.
remaining_icons.flavour: Nobody on this squad fights alone. Not even you.

remaining_icons.name: Their Own Idea
remaining_icons.action: Wick whispers behind one mitten toward a big ear (partial, from the frame edge), above which a lightbulb has just switched on.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per scene, hide a suggestion inside a sentence. The listener believes it was their own idea and acts on it, unless it would harm them directly.
remaining_icons.flavour: You never told them. You just let them get there.

remaining_icons.name: The Twin Pays
remaining_icons.action: Wick holds a soul flame high in one mitten while a coin drops from the top edge of the frame into its other open mitten.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per combat, cast a Soul spell with no mana and no Strain: your twin in the upper realm pays for it.
remaining_icons.flavour: Up there, someone with your face flinches. Down here, the spell lands.

remaining_icons.name: True Name
remaining_icons.action: Wick holds up an unrolled scroll showing one sigil (a symbol, never letters) toward a huge horned shadow at the frame edge, which shrinks back.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per session, name an upper-realm being, curse or creature you've studied. For the rest of the scene it takes +50% damage from you and your allies, and it can't lie to you.
remaining_icons.flavour: You know what it's called. It knows you know.

remaining_icons.name: Still Water
remaining_icons.action: Wick sits perfectly still on one stepping stone in flat water, a tea bowl balanced on its head, no ripple anywhere.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: You're immune to Brain Debuffs, and nothing reads you: not your intent, your lies or your HP, not even Analyze or Empathy.
remaining_icons.flavour: Nothing goes in. Nothing comes out.

remaining_icons.name: Judgement Day
remaining_icons.action: Wick raises a tall crozier staff overhead and a single shaft of light spears down from above onto the ground in front of it.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per combat, 3 AP: judge one enemy you can see. Its next attack against an ally fails, and your attacks against it deal +50% damage until the combat ends.
remaining_icons.flavour: The saints have looked. They've decided.

remaining_icons.name: Foreseen
remaining_icons.action: Wick stands at a signpost at a fork; one arrow is crossed out, and Wick glances back over its shoulder toward it before taking the other road.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per session, after a major decision goes wrong, rewind to just before it. The Narrator tells you what would have happened, and you choose again.
remaining_icons.flavour: You saw where it led. This time you take the other road.

remaining_icons.name: On My Mark
remaining_icons.action: Wick leans forward pointing hard with one mitten, a whistle at its screen, cape snapping; motion lines run the way it points.
remaining_icons.mastered_mark: small four-pointed star, upper left, same size and place on all 27
remaining_icons.rules_text: Once per round, 1 AP: order an ally who can hear you. They take one action right away, outside their turn, paying with their own AP.
remaining_icons.flavour: You say go. They're already gone.
